question: Which of the following antiarrhythmic drugs can produce thyroid alterations as an adverse effect ?:

analysis: Amiodarone is known to cause thyroid alterations as an adverse effect due to its high iodine content, which can lead to either hypothyroidism or hyperthyroidism. The other drugs listed do not have a significant impact on thyroid function.
